exposure: Time of day of dinoprostone insertion
outcome: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 1562 women at 37 weeks 0 days to 41 weeks 6 days of gestation who underwent dinoprostone-induced labor between January 1st, 2019, and December 31st, 2021 in central China
finding: Multiparity, advanced maternal age, fetal macrosomia, premature rupture of membranes (PROM), and daytime insertion of dinoprostone were significant factors influencing time to vaginal delivery in women undergoing labor induction with dinoprostone vaginal inserts.
